name: spmt-prioritization-board
description: Tooling for the SPMT prioritization board. The board itself has no dependencies; these are for checks only.

scripts.check: npm run check:card --silent && npm run check:grid --silent && npm run parity --silent
scripts.audit: npm run audit:export && npm run audit:ppt && npm run audit:other && npm run audit:board
scripts.verify:grid: npm run controls --silent && npm run inspector --silent && npm run toolbar --silent
